scanNote:
WORKBOOK 44-BET. Unit 11 — sifat va ravish.

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. HAMMASI TO'G'RI: 1-mashq (6 variant), 2a (6 tuzatish), 2b (6 gap), 3-mashq (6 sinonim), 4-mashq (7 ravish), 5-mashq (10 tanlov) — jami 41 ta javob.

⚠ 5-MAShQNING QOIDASI — SIFATMI YOKI RAVIShMI:
  OTDAN OLDIN → SIFAT: 'the COMFORTABLE armchair', 'a BRIGHT light'
  'BE' FE'LIDAN KEYIN → SIFAT: 'The exam was EASY', 'they were LUCKY'
  BOShQA FE'LDAN KEYIN → RAVISh: 'sang WELL', 'reached SAFELY', 'opened QUIETLY', 'climbed SLOWLY', 'held PROUDLY'
  GAP BOShIDA → RAVISh: 'SUDDENLY, he started to run'
  ⚠ Tekshirish savoli: 'Qanday?' deb so'rasa bo'lsa — ravish; 'Qanaqa?' deb so'rasa bo'lsa — sifat.

⚠ 'GOOD' va 'WELL' — ENG KO'P XATO: 'The singers sang WELL' ('sang good' XATO). 'good' — sifat, 'well' — uning ravish shakli.

⚠ 4-MAShQ — YETTI RAVISh, YETTI BO'ShLIQ, HAR BIRI BIR MARTADAN. Hikoyaning mantiqidan topiladi:
  esnash → SLEEPILY · haydash maslahati → CAREFULLY · derazani yopish → TIGHTLY
  jilmayish (yangi ish) → HAPPILY · avtohalokat → LOUDLY · shoshilib yugurish → QUICKLY · savol berish → POLITELY

⚠ 2a — SIFAT MA'NOSI GAPGA ZID: har bandda so'z grammatik to'g'ri, lekin MA'NOSI mos emas:
  'scared but SAD to be alive' → HAPPY · 'WONDERFUL when my house caught fire' → HORRIBLE
  'CARELESSLY because he didn't want to break it' → CAREFULLY
  'SLOWLY jumped out of the burning car' → QUICKLY
  'HAPPILY shouted Help me!' → DESPERATELY · 'felt BRAVE because the lions were scary' → NERVOUS

exercises.explanationUz:
Barcha so'zlar Coursebook 11-unitidagi ikki hikoyadan
olingan (safari park va Hans Brinker).

USUL — GAPNING MA'NOSIGA QARANG:
  Har bir bandda kontekst javobni ochib beradi.
     'a very funny story' → kulish → laughed
     'the hole in the roof' → tuzatish → mended

items.textEn: 1  He told us a very funny story and everybody ............ .
items.whyUz:
'a very FUNNY story' → odamlar KULADI → LAUGHED.
'shouted' = qichqirdi;  'screamed' = chinqirdi —
ikkalasi ham kulgili hikoyaga mos kelmaydi.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'Claire LAUGHED'.

items.textEn: 2  There is a beautiful ............ from the top of the hill.
items.whyUz:
'a beautiful VIEW' = go'zal manzara.
'FROM the top of the hill' — 'from' manzara qayerdan
ko'rinishini ko'rsatadi → VIEW.
Coursebook 78-betda ham: 'The VIEW from there was beautiful!'
'a field' = dala;  'a lake' = ko'l — ular manzara EMAS.

items.textEn: 3  Tom ............ the hole in the roof.
items.whyUz:
'MENDED the hole' = teshikni tuzatdi.
'to mend' = ta'mirlamoq (buyum, teshik uchun).
Coursebook 80-betda: 'they quickly MENDED the hole'.
DIQQAT: 'to correct' = XATONI to'g'rilamoq (matn, javob) —
teshik uchun ishlatilmaydi.

items.textEn: 4  Rain began to ............ heavily from the dark sky.
items.whyUz:
'rain began to FALL' = yomg'ir yog'a boshladi.
Coursebook 80-betda: 'heavy rain began to FALL'.
DIQQAT: 'fall' bu yerda YOG'MOQ ma'nosida
(78-betda esa YIQILMOQ ma'nosida edi).
'heavily' — RAVISh.

items.textEn: 5  When we went to the zoo, I ............ photographs of all the animals.
items.whyUz:
'TAKE photographs' = suratga olmoq — turg'un birikma.
take → TOOK (noto'g'ri fe'l).
Coursebook 77-betda: 'started TAKING PICTURES of them'.
DIQQAT: 'make photographs' va 'do photographs' XATO.

items.textEn: 6  Simon ............ the horn and waved goodbye.
items.whyUz:
'BEEP the horn' = signal chalmoq — turg'un birikma.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'She BEEPED THE HORN'.
'to touch' = tegmoq;  'to hit' = urmoq —
ikkalasi ham signal uchun ishlatilmaydi.
'to wave goodbye' = qo'l silkib xayrlashmoq.

exercises.instructionEn: Use words from the list to correct the mistakes in the sentences.
exercises.instructionUz: Ro'yxatdagi so'zlar bilan gaplardagi xatolarni to'g'rilang.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta so'z, 6 ta gap):
  happy, quickly, carefully, horrible, desperately, nervous

Har bir gapda QALIN yozilgan so'z MANTIQAN XATO —
uni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri so'z bilan almashtirasiz.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  We were very scared, but ~~SAD~~ to be alive.
     → HAPPY
     (Tirik qolgani uchun 'sad' emas, 'happy' bo'lishi kerak.)

USUL — MANTIQIY ZIDDIYATNI TOPING:
  Har bir gapda qalin so'z gapning qolgan qismiga
  QARAMA-QARShI keladi.
     'didn't want to break it' ↔ 'carelessly' — ziddiyat
     'burning car' ↔ 'slowly' — ziddiyat

DIQQAT — SIFAT yoki RAVISh:
  Almashtirilgan so'z ham BIR XIL TURDA bo'lishi kerak:
     sad (sifat)        → happy (sifat)
     carelessly (ravish) → carefully (ravish)

items.textEn: 1  We were very scared, but SAD to be alive.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
Tirik qolgani uchun 'sad' (g'amgin) EMAS,
'HAPPY' (xursand) bo'lishi kerak.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'They were still shocked, but HAPPY.'
Ikkalasi ham SIFAT.

items.textEn: 2  It was a WONDERFUL experience when my house caught fire.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
Uy yong'ini 'wonderful' (ajoyib) BO'LOLMAYDI →
'HORRIBLE' (dahshatli).
Coursebook 78-betda: 'It was a HORRIBLE experience!'
'catch fire' = yona boshlamoq;  catch → CAUGHT.

items.textEn: 3  He put the vase down CARELESSLY because he didn't want to break it.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'didn't want to break it' → EHTIYOTKORLIK bilan qo'ygan →
'CAREFULLY'.
'carelessly' (ehtiyotsizlik bilan) — mantiqiy ZIDDIYAT.
Ikkalasi ham RAVISh.
'a vase' = vaza.

items.textEn: 4  They SLOWLY jumped out of the burning car and ran to safety.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
Yonayotgan mashinadan TEZ chiqiladi → 'QUICKLY'.
'slowly' (sekin) — mantiqiy ZIDDIYAT.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'jumped out of the car QUICKLY'.
'run to safety' = xavfsiz joyga yugurmoq.

items.textEn: 5  "Please, someone help me!" John shouted HAPPILY.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
Yordam so'rab qichqirish 'happily' (xursand) BO'LMAYDI →
'DESPERATELY' (jon holatda).
Coursebook 77-betda: 'Claire screamed DESPERATELY'.
80-betda ham: 'Please, someone help me!'
Ikkalasi ham RAVISh.

items.textEn: 6  Elaine felt BRAVE because the lions were very scary.  →  ?
items.hintUz: Qo'rqinchli sherlar oldida qanday his qilinadi?
items.whyUz:
Sherlar qo'rqinchli bo'lsa, 'brave' (jasur) emas,
'NERVOUS' (asabiy, xavotirli) his qilinadi.
'because' — sabab: sherlar qo'rqinchli edi.
Ikkalasi ham SIFAT.
'feel + SIFAT' — 49-betdagi qoida.

exercises.instructionEn: Now make sentences using the words in bold from Ex. 2a.
exercises.instructionUz: Endi 2a-mashqdagi qalin so'zlar bilan gaplar tuzing.
exercises.explanationUz:
2a-MAShQDAGI QALIN (XATO) SO'ZLAR:
  sad, wonderful, carelessly, slowly, happily, brave

Ular 2a da NOTO'G'RI kontekstda edi —
endi TO'G'RI kontekstda gap tuzasiz.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  I was very SAD when my best friend went to live in
  another town.

DIQQAT — SO'Z TURI:
  SIFATLAR: sad, wonderful, brave
     'to be' yoki 'feel' dan keyin, yoki otdan oldin.
  RAVIShLAR: carelessly, slowly, happily
     fe'ldan keyin.

items.textEn: sad  (sifat)
items.answer: I was very sad when my best friend went to live in another town.
items.whyUz:
'sad' — SIFAT, 'was' dan keyin turibdi.
'when' — vaqt bog'lovchisi.

items.textEn: wonderful  (sifat)
items.answer: We had a wonderful time at the beach last summer.
items.whyUz:
'wonderful' — SIFAT, otdan OLDIN turibdi
('a wonderful time').
2a-mashqda u yong'in haqida edi — noto'g'ri kontekst.
Bu yerda ijobiy voqea haqida — to'g'ri.

items.textEn: carelessly  (ravish)
items.answer: He drove carelessly and had an accident.
items.whyUz:
'carelessly' — RAVISh, 'drove' fe'lidan keyin.
2a-mashqda u vazani ehtiyot bilan qo'yish haqida edi —
ziddiyat. Bu yerda esa natija mos keladi (halokat).

items.textEn: slowly  (ravish)
items.answer: The old man walked slowly down the street.
items.whyUz:
'slowly' — RAVISh, 'walked' fe'lidan keyin.
2a-mashqda yonayotgan mashina bilan ziddiyat edi.
Bu yerda keksa odam — mantiqan to'g'ri.

items.textEn: happily  (ravish)
items.answer: The children played happily in the garden.
items.whyUz:
'happily' — RAVISh, 'played' fe'lidan keyin.
2a-mashqda yordam so'rash bilan ziddiyat edi.
Bu yerda bolalar o'yini — mos keladi.

items.textEn: brave  (sifat)
items.answer: Everyone was very proud of that brave little boy.
items.whyUz:
'brave' — SIFAT, otdan OLDIN turibdi.
Coursebook 80-betdagi Hans Brinker hikoyasining
oxirgi gapi.
2a-mashqda sherlar oldida — ziddiyat edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Replace the words in bold with synonymous words from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Qalin yozilgan so'zlarni ro'yxatdagi ma'nodosh so'zlar bilan almashtiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (6 ta so'z, 6 ta gap):
  object, began, frightened, gorgeous, huge, noises

MA'NODOSh (sinonim) so'zlar — ma'nosi bir xil,
lekin so'z boshqa.

KITOBDAGI NAMUNA:
  1  She saw a strange THING in the sky.  →  OBJECT

OLTI MA'NODOSh JUFTLIK:
  thing    → object      (narsa → buyum)
  lovely   → gorgeous    (yoqimli → ajoyib)
  started  → began       (boshladi → boshladi)
  big      → huge        (katta → juda katta)
  scared   → frightened  (qo'rqqan → qo'rqib ketgan)
  sounds   → noises      (ovozlar → shovqinlar)

DIQQAT — SO'Z TURI SAQLANADI:
  ot → ot;  sifat → sifat;  fe'l → fe'l
  Va FE'L SHAKLI ham saqlanadi:
     started (o'tgan) → began (o'tgan)

items.textEn: 1  She saw a strange THING in the sky.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'a thing' = narsa → 'an OBJECT' = buyum, jism.
Coursebook 78-betdagi 10a-mashqda ham:
'He had a metal OBJECT in his hand'.
Ikkalasi ham OT.

items.textEn: 2  It was a LOVELY day so we went to the beach.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'lovely' = yoqimli → 'GORGEOUS' = ajoyib, go'zal.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'One GORGEOUS, sunny day'.
Ikkalasi ham SIFAT.
'so' — natija bog'lovchisi.

items.textEn: 3  Suddenly the sky got dark and it STARTED to rain.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'started' = boshladi → 'BEGAN' = boshladi.
Coursebook 80-betda: 'heavy rain BEGAN to fall'.
DIQQAT: FE'L ShAKLI ham saqlanadi —
ikkalasi ham O'TGAN zamonda.
begin → BEGAN (noto'g'ri fe'l).

items.textEn: 4  After the earthquake there was a BIG hole in the ground.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'big' = katta → 'HUGE' = juda katta, ulkan.
'huge' — 'big' dan KUChLIROQ.
Zilziladan keyingi teshik uchun mos.
'an earthquake' = zilzila (earth + quake).

items.textEn: 5  I was very SCARED when the dog barked at me.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'scared' = qo'rqqan → 'FRIGHTENED' = qo'rqib ketgan.
Coursebook 80-betda: 'Hans felt FRIGHTENED'.
Ikkalasi ham -ED sifati — ODAM haqida.
'to bark AT somebody' = kimgadir hurmoq.

items.textEn: 6  Kevin heard strange SOUNDS coming from the kitchen.  →  ?
items.whyUz:
'sounds' = ovozlar → 'NOISES' = shovqinlar.
DIQQAT — nozik farq:
  'a sound' — HAR QANDAY ovoz (yoqimli ham)
  'a noise' — odatda YOQIMSIZ, bezovta qiluvchi ovoz
Bu yerda 'strange' (g'alati) bo'lgani uchun 'noises' mos.
Coursebook 79 va 81-betlarda ham 'noises' bor edi.

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct adverb from the list.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni ro'yxatdagi to'g'ri ravish bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
RO'YXAT (7 ta ravish, 7 ta bo'shliq):
  carefully, quickly, tightly, sleepily, loudly,
  politely, happily

Har biri AYNAN BIR MARTA ishlatiladi.

TO'LIQ MATN (to'ldirilgan holda):

  Tom's wife yawned SLEEPILY as she stood at the front
  door. "Goodbye, Tom. Drive CAREFULLY," she called. Tom
  got into the car. It was a cold morning, so he closed the
  windows TIGHTLY. As he drove along he smiled HAPPILY.
  Today was his first day in his new job. Suddenly, the car
  skidded on the icy road. Tom screamed LOUDLY as his car
  crashed into a tree. Someone called an ambulance, which
  soon arrived. The driver ran QUICKLY towards Tom. "Are
  you alright, sir?" he asked POLITELY. "Yes," said Tom.
  "But I don't think my car is."


O'ZBEKChA TARJIMASI:
  Tomning xotini eshik oldida turib uyqusirab esnadi.
  "Xayr, Tom. Ehtiyot bo'lib hayda," — dedi u. Tom
  mashinaga o'tirdi. Sovuq tong edi, shuning uchun
  oynalarni mahkam yopdi. Yo'l bo'ylab ketayotib baxtli
  jilmaydi. Bugun uning yangi ishidagi birinchi kuni edi.
  To'satdan mashina muzli yo'lda sirg'anib ketdi. Mashinasi
  daraxtga urilganda Tom baland ovozda qichqirdi. Kimdir
  tez yordam chaqirdi va u tez orada yetib keldi. Haydovchi
  Tom tomon tez yugurdi. "Yaxshimisiz, janob?" — deb
  muloyimlik bilan so'radi u. "Ha," — dedi Tom. "Lekin
  mashinam yaxshi emas deb o'ylayman."


USUL — HAR BIR FE'LGA SAVOL BERING:
  yawned ...      → qanday esnadi?  → sleepily
  Drive ...       → qanday hayda?   → carefully
  closed ...      → qanday yopdi?   → tightly
  smiled ...      → qanday jilmaydi? → happily
  screamed ...    → qanday qichqirdi? → loudly
  ran ...         → qanday yugurdi?  → quickly
  asked ...       → qanday so'radi?  → politely

HIKOYANING OXIRI — HAZIL:
  Tom 'Yaxshimisiz?' savoliga 'Ha' deb javob beradi,
  lekin qo'shib qo'yadi: 'Lekin mashinam yaxshi emas'.
  Ya'ni o'zi sog'-salomat, mashinasi esa buzilgan.

YANGI SO'ZLAR:
  to yawn      = esnamoq
  the front door = old eshik
  to skid      = sirg'anib ketmoq
  icy          = muzli
  to crash into = ...ga urilmoq
  an ambulance = tez yordam
  alright      = yaxshi, joyida (= all right)
  politely     = muloyimlik bilan

items.textEn: 1  Tom's wife yawned ............ as she stood at the front door.
items.whyUz:
'yawned SLEEPILY' = uyqusirab esnadi.
'to yawn' = esnamoq — uyqu belgisi.
Coursebook 81-betdagi 21-mashqda ham 'sleepily' bor edi.
'sleepy' + -ILY (undosh + Y qoidasi).

items.textEn: 2  "Goodbye, Tom. Drive ............ ," she called.
items.whyUz:
'Drive CAREFULLY' = ehtiyot bo'lib hayda —
yo'lga chiqayotganga aytiladigan standart ibora.
Grammar 48-betdagi asosiy namuna:
'He drives CAREFULLY.'

items.textEn: 3  It was a cold morning, so he closed the windows ............ .
items.whyUz:
'closed the windows TIGHTLY' = oynalarni mahkam yopdi.
Sovuq bo'lgani uchun mahkam yopgan.
Coursebook 77-betda ham: 'closed the car windows TIGHTLY'.

items.textEn: 4  As he drove along he smiled ............ .
items.hintUz: Yangi ishga ketayotgan odam qanday jilmayadi?
items.whyUz:
'smiled HAPPILY' = baxtli jilmaydi.
Keyingi gap sababini aytadi: 'Today was his first day
in his new job' — yangi ish, shuning uchun xursand.
'happy' + -ILY (undosh + Y qoidasi).
'drive ALONG' — harakat predlogi.

items.textEn: 5  Tom screamed ............ as his car crashed into a tree.
items.whyUz:
'screamed LOUDLY' = baland ovozda qichqirdi.
'crash INTO a tree' = daraxtga urilmoq — 'into' predlogi.
'to skid' = sirg'anib ketmoq;  'icy' = muzli.

items.textEn: 6  The driver ran ............ towards Tom.
items.whyUz:
'ran QUICKLY' = tez yugurdi.
Favqulodda vaziyatda tez harakat qilinadi.
'run TOWARDS' — yo'nalish predlogi (Coursebook 77-betda ham).
'the driver' bu yerda — tez yordam haydovchisi.

items.textEn: 7  "Are you alright, sir?" he asked ............ .
items.whyUz:
'asked POLITELY' = muloyimlik bilan so'radi.
BELGI: gapda 'SIR' bor — bu MULOYIM murojaat.
'polite' = muloyim → 'politely' = muloyimlik bilan.
'alright' = yaxshi, joyida ('all right' ning qisqasi).

exercises.explanationUz:
SIFATMI YOKI RAVIShMI — QANDAY ANIQLASh:

  SIFAT KERAK:
     • OTDAN OLDIN turadi
          a COMFORTABLE armchair;  a BRIGHT light
     • 'to be' dan KEYIN turadi
          The exam was EASY.
          They were LUCKY.

  RAVISh KERAK:
     • FE'LNI aniqlaydi
          sang WELL;  opened the door QUIETLY;
          climbed SLOWLY;  held his award PROUDLY
     • butun gapga tegishli bo'lsa (gap boshida)
          SUDDENLY, he started to run.

USUL — SAVOL BERING:
  'WHAT KIND OF ...?' (qanday?)  → SIFAT
  'HOW ...?' (qanday qilib?)      → RAVISh

DIQQAT — 5-BAND ALDAMChI:
  'They reached the river SAFELY.'
  'reached' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh.
  ('safe' bo'lsa 'They were safe' bo'lardi.)

items.textEn: 1  He sat in the comfortable / comfortably armchair.
items.whyUz:
'armchair' OTINI aniqlaydi → SIFAT → COMFORTABLE.
Sifat otdan OLDIN turadi.
'an armchair' = kreslo;  'comfortable' = qulay.

items.textEn: 2  The singers sang very good / well.
items.whyUz:
'sang' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh kerak.
'good' ning ravishi — WELL (ISTISNO).
'sang very good' XATO — juda ko'p uchraydigan xato.
Grammar 48-betdagi 'Note: good → well'.

items.textEn: 3  Sudden / Suddenly, he started to run.
items.hintUz: Gap boshida turibdi — butun gapga tegishli
items.whyUz:
'SUDDENLY' — RAVISh, gap boshida, butun gapga tegishli.
'Sudden' SIFAT — otdan oldin turishi kerak edi
('a sudden noise').
Oldidan VERGUL bor — bu ham ravishni ko'rsatadi.

items.textEn: 4  The exam was very easy / easily.
items.whyUz:
'was' ('to be') dan keyin SIFAT keladi → EASY.
'The exam was easily' XATO.
DIQQAT: 'He passed the exam EASILY' bo'lsa —
u yerda 'passed' fe'lini aniqlaydi → ravish.

items.textEn: 5  They reached the river safe / safely.
items.whyUz:
'reached' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh → SAFELY.
Savol: qanday yetib bordilar? Xavfsiz holda.
DIQQAT: 'They were SAFE' bo'lsa — 'were' dan keyin SIFAT.
Bu yerda esa 'reached' fe'li bor.
'to reach' = yetib bormoq (predlogsiz!).

items.textEn: 6  They knew they were lucky / luckily to be alive.
items.whyUz:
'were' ('to be') dan keyin SIFAT keladi → LUCKY.
Coursebook 77-betda: 'they were very LUCKY to be alive'.
DIQQAT: 'LUCKILY, they were alive' bo'lsa —
u yerda gap boshida, butun gapga tegishli → ravish.

items.textEn: 7  She opened the door quiet / quietly.
items.whyUz:
'opened' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh → QUIETLY.
Savol: qanday ochdi? Jimgina.
'quiet' = tinch, jim (SIFAT).

items.textEn: 8  They saw a bright / brightly light in the sky.
items.whyUz:
'light' OTINI aniqlaydi → SIFAT → BRIGHT.
Sifat otdan OLDIN turadi.
Coursebook 78-betdagi 10a-mashqda ham:
'she saw a BRIGHT light in the sky'.

items.textEn: 9  Tony climbed slow / slowly down the ladder.
items.whyUz:
'climbed' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh → SLOWLY.
Savol: qanday tushdi? Sekin.
Coursebook 81-betdagi 21-mashqda ham:
'He climbed carefully DOWN' — narvondan tushish.
'a ladder' = narvon.

items.textEn: 10  The actor held his award proud / proudly.
items.whyUz:
'held' FE'LINI aniqlaydi → RAVISh → PROUDLY.
Savol: qanday ushladi? Faxr bilan.
hold → HELD (noto'g'ri fe'l).
DIQQAT: 'The actor was PROUD' bo'lsa —
'was' dan keyin SIFAT.
Coursebook 79-betda: 'He felt PROUD with the gold cup'.

patterns.exampleEn: Tom's wife yawned sleepily. He asked politely. The driver ran quickly.
patterns.exampleUz: Tomning xotini uyqusirab esnadi. U muloyimlik bilan so'radi. Haydovchi tez yugurdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
RAVISh fe'ldan KEYIN turadi va 'How ...?' savoliga
javob beradi.

patterns.formula: Ega + WAS/WERE + SIFAT.   ↔   Ega + FE'L + RAVISh.
patterns.exampleEn: The exam was easy. / He passed the exam easily.
patterns.exampleUz: Imtihon oson edi. / U imtihondan osonlik bilan o'tdi.
patterns.explanationUz:
'to be' dan keyin SIFAT;
fe'ldan keyin RAVISh.

patterns.formula: Ega + saw / bought + A + SIFAT + OT.
patterns.exampleEn: They saw a bright light in the sky. He sat in the comfortable armchair.
patterns.exampleUz: Ular osmonda yorqin nurni ko'rishdi. U qulay kresloga o'tirdi.
